description: This file defines a static class CacheHelpers containing methods to generate cache keys related to catalog items, brands, and types for caching purposes in a web application.

classes.name: CacheHelpers
classes.description: A static class providing helper methods to generate cache keys for catalog data and predefined cache duration.

methods.name: GenerateCatalogItemCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for catalog items based on pagination and optional filters for brand and type.

methods.name: GenerateBrandsCacheKey
methods.description: Returns a fixed cache key string for brands.

methods.name: GenerateTypesCacheKey
methods.description: Returns a fixed cache key string for types.
